scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w contracts
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.deploy:yirs:testnet: npm run build -w contracts && npm run deploy:testnet -w contracts
